execution_notes: All people, organisations, addresses and references are invented; the John Doe email is the mandated assignment fixture, and all other email and social-link domains use example.com.
Load the corpus before search evaluation; fixture ids identify results regardless of any ids allocated by an implementation, and preserve document ownership when mapping them.
Run each HTTP case independently against the same initial corpus; generated records from happy paths must not contaminate query judgements.
Query q values are decoded text: URL-encode them once as parameter values, preserving quotes, punctuation and whitespace.
Results match their own searchable text, not every field of their owner or every document attached to a matching client; full-name queries include documents that explicitly identify that person.

The unqualified address proof query seeks usable evidence of residence: recent household utility bills, a current council tax bill and a recent bank statement qualify, but delivery receipts, repair invoices, employment letters and a pending mortgage offer do not.
Absent first imposes no ranking constraint; an acceptable client on a name-plus-document query is a useful navigation result, but the requested document must rank first.
HTTP cases with raw_body must transmit that exact UTF-8 string with the specified Content-Type instead of JSON-serialising body; otherwise JSON-serialise non-null body and send no body for null.
expected_response_schema uses JSON Schema assertions for response checks; no upper query length is specified, so the oversized relevance case is nice rather than a required availability test.
Blank and whitespace-only searches return an empty array: q is present, no minLength is stated, and there is no search intent authorising an all-records listing.
HTTP expected_query_id also applies that query’s relevance and ranking assertions; remap c02 in the document path and response schema to the loaded fixture id if the API allocates ids.

A JSON number is not the required first_name string and must not be silently stored as a name.
An array is not a last_name string.
A numeric email violates both the string type and email format requirements.
A description must be a string, not an object containing a string.
A single string is not the required social_links array.
Every social_links element must be a string, so a mixed array containing a number is invalid.
The raw request has a trailing comma and is malformed JSON, so it must fail parsing rather than create a client.
